items.title: 今年上半狂虧逾6億美元！川普媒體科技集團放棄加密貨幣 豪賭核融合技術
items.title_en: Trump Media & Technology Group Abandons Crypto After $600M+ H1 Loss, Bets on Fusion Energy
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，美國總統川普旗下川普媒體與科技集團 (TMTG) 正大幅轉向，退出加密貨幣交易、推動出售 Truth Social 發文即時存取權，並將資源押注尚無收入的核融合能源。
英國《金融時報》報導，Truth Social 母公司 TMTG 最新財報顯示，今年第二季淨虧損 2.38 億美元，營收僅 170 萬美元，總資產近 20 億美元，今年上半年累計虧損擴大至 6.44 億美元，遠高於去年同期 5200 萬美元，公司歸咎於比特幣價格下跌導致數位資產減損。
戰略層面上，TMTG 確認繼續推進與目前營收為零、核融合新創公司 TAE Technologies 規模超 60 億美元的全股票合併，目標 2026 年選址建首座 50 兆瓦級示範廠、2031 年商轉。
TMTG 代理執行長 Kevin McGurn 指出，AI 與資料中心用電暴增使能源成「戰略資產」，TMTG 也正與雲端巨頭、新聞機構及大模型業者洽談，並計畫向散戶交易者擴展業務。
最新數據顯示，主業 Truth Social 流量持續失血。根據 Similarweb 預估，7 月移動端日活躍用戶數約 26.1 萬，較一年前 43.6 萬明顯下滑，TMTG 股價今年累計下跌近 30%。川普名下可撤銷信託持 1.15 億股、價值逾 10 億美元，為唯一受益人。
報導指出，TMTG 從「政治社交平台」跨向「AI 電力概念」的估值邏輯重寫，短期靠資產負債表撐住門面，但核心用戶黏性弱化、核融合商轉仍遙遠，能否兌現資本市場預期仍待觀察。
paras_en: Foreign media reports indicate that Donald Trump’s Trump Media & Technology Group (TMTG) is making a major shift, exiting cryptocurrency trading, pushing the sale of real‑time posting access on Truth Social, and betting its resources on revenue‑less nuclear‑fusion energy.

The Financial Times reports that TMTG’s latest financials show a Q2 net loss of $238 million, revenue of only $1.7 million, total assets near $2 billion, and a cumulative H1 loss of $644 million – far above last year’s $52 million loss, which the company blames on digital‑asset impairments from falling Bitcoin prices.

Strategically, TMTG confirmed it will continue pursuing an all‑stock merger with zero‑revenue fusion startup TAE Technologies, valued at over $6 billion, aiming to site a 50‑megawatt demonstration plant by 2026 and commence commercial operation by 2031.

TMTG interim CEO Kevin McGurn said that surging AI and data‑center power consumption makes energy a “strategic asset,” and TMTG is in talks with cloud giants, news organisations and large‑model firms while planning to expand services to retail traders.

Latest data show Truth Social’s core business continues to bleed traffic. SimilarWeb estimates July mobile daily active users at about 261,000, down sharply from 436,000 a year earlier, and TMTG’s stock has fallen nearly 30% YTD. Trump’s revocable trust holds 115 million shares worth over $1 billion as the sole beneficiary.

The report notes that TMTG is rewriting its valuation logic from a “political social platform” to an “AI‑power concept,” propping up its façade with the balance sheet in the short term, but with weakening core user stickiness and fusion commercialization still distant, it remains to be seen whether it can meet capital‑market expectations.

items.title: AI股跌夠沒？高盛最新研判「4大過熱風險」已降溫
items.title_en: Have AI Stocks Fallen Enough? Goldman Sachs' Latest View: 4 Key Risks Have Cooled Down
paras: 受全球 AI 交易大幅逆轉影響，中國 AI 硬科技股自 6 月高點明顯回落，科創 50、創業板及中證 1000 等指數均出現修正。高盛最新研判指出，隨著這波回調展開，市場先前累積的投機性多頭、估值溢價、槓桿及持倉集中風險已有相當程度消化，加上 AI 基本面與流動性趨勢仍偏正向，因此維持對 A 股結構性看好與超配觀點。
整體 AI 類股尚未形成明顯泡沫
高盛首席中國股票策略師劉勁津表示，從自上而下角度觀察，中國所有 AI 相關股票的總市值，尚未完全反映 AI 可能為整體經濟帶來的潛在收益。若從總市值與潛在經濟貢獻的關係來看，目前中國 AI 板塊並不存在非常明顯的整體性泡沫。
不過，局部過熱確實曾經出現。2026 年上半年，不同區域市場、產業與投資主題間的報酬分化，一度升至前所未有的程度，中國市場尤其呈現 AI 硬科技與軟科技明顯分化。
過去一個月，隨全球 AI 硬體交易出現平倉，先前累積的超額報酬已顯著回吐。高盛認為，從價格動能來看，這波市場調整與風格輪動應開始趨於緩和。
估值也已明顯降溫。6 月下旬，A 股硬科技公司估值一度升至階段高點，但經過本輪回調後，目前本益比已回落至長期平均水準、甚至更低，尤其納入企業成長潛力考量後，估值壓力已有所舒緩。
AI 資本支出仍是基本面核心支撐
基本面方面，高盛認為，AI 資本支出熱潮仍是全球 AI 相關股票上漲最主要的驅動力。該行估算，2026 年中美 9 家大型雲端服務商的 AI 相關支出總額可能超過 9,000 億美元，2027 年進一步增至 1.3 兆美元。
這波支出已帶來強勁的營收與獲利動能，並沿全球 AI 價值鏈產生「漣漪效應」，受惠範圍涵蓋韓國記憶體晶片業者、日本半導體材料與設備供應商，以及中國電力與基礎設施領域的科技公司。
今年以來，全球前 8 大上市中美雲端服務商 2026 年、2027 年資本支出市場預期已分別上調 32% 與 75%，帶動硬科技板塊 2026 及 2027 財年獲利預測在前 7 個月分別上修 12% 與 22%。
因此，接下來財報季大型雲端服務商釋出的資本支出指引，以及 AI 發展與變現路線圖，將成為未來數月 AI 投資敘事的重要觀察指標。
短期波動仍高、但機會正在浮現
高盛指出，短期市場波動率可能仍維持高檔，但投資人仍應持續關注中國 AI 生態系。
配置方向上，可分批布局估值位於週期低點的 H 股網路及軟科技股，隨外賣、即時配送等業務補貼虧損逐步收窄，加上雲端運算、AI 智能體與 Token 消費的變現動能增強，戰術性投資價值正在提升。
此外，高盛也看好 AI 及非 AI 領域的政策受惠標的，包括生技醫藥、服務消費、先進製造與農業等，同時建議重新聚焦獲利基本面，留意本輪修正中遭錯殺、但仍具堅實獲利支撐的成長股，並持續挖掘 IPO 市場超額報酬及股東回報相關機會。
整體而言，這波 AI 回調與風格輪動開始趨緩，但短期波動率仍可能維持高檔；在 AI 資本支出與基本面趨勢仍具支撐下，市場焦點正逐步從「全面追逐 AI」轉向估值、獲利與個股基本面的重新篩選。
paras_en: China's AI hardware technology stocks have fallen significantly since June, with the CSI 50, ChiNext, and CSI 1000 indices all experiencing corrections. Goldman Sachs' latest view is that, as this correction unfolds, the market's earlier accumulated speculative sentiment, valuation overpricing, leverage, and concentrated holdings risk have been significantly digested. Additionally, the AI fundamentals and liquidity trend remain positive, so Goldman Sachs maintains a positive view on the A-share structural and overweight perspective.
The overall AI sector stocks have not yet formed a clear bubble.

Goldman Sachs' Chief China Equity Strategist, Liu Jingjin, said from a top-down perspective, the total market value of all Chinese AI-related stocks has not yet fully reflected the potential benefits that AI may bring to the overall economy. If we look at the relationship between total market value and potential economic contributions, there is no obvious overall bubble in the Chinese AI sector.

However, local overheating has indeed occurred. In the first half of 2026, the return differentiation between different regional markets, industries, and investment themes reached an unprecedented level, with the Chinese market showing a clear differentiation between AI hardware technology and software technology.

Over the past month, as global AI hardware trading has seen a net outflow, the excess returns accumulated earlier have been significantly returned. Goldman Sachs believes that, from a price momentum perspective, this market adjustment and style rotation should begin to ease.

Valuations have also cooled down significantly. In late June, the A-share hard technology company valuations reached a peak, but after this round of correction, the current P/E ratio has fallen to the long-term average, and even lower, especially considering the company's growth potential. The valuation pressure has eased.
AI capital expenditures remain the core support for the fundamentals.

From a fundamental perspective, Goldman Sachs believes that the AI capital expenditure wave remains the main driver of the global AI-related stocks' rise. The firm estimates that the total AI-related expenditures of the top 9 US and Chinese cloud service providers may exceed $900 billion in 2026 and reach $1.3 trillion in 2027.

This wave of expenditures has brought strong revenue and profit momentum, and has produced a 'ripple effect' along the global AI value chain, benefiting Korean memory chip makers, Japanese semiconductor materials and equipment suppliers, and Chinese technology companies in the power and infrastructure sectors.

This year, the market expectations for the 2026 and 2027 capital expenditures of the top 8 listed US and Chinese cloud service providers have been raised by 32% and 75%, respectively, driving the hard technology sector's 2026 and 2027 earnings forecast to be revised up by 12% and 22%, respectively, in the first 7 months.

Therefore, the capital expenditure guidance and AI development and monetization roadmaps released by large cloud service providers in the coming earnings season will become important observation indicators for future AI investment narratives.
Short-term volatility remains high, but opportunities are emerging.
Goldman Sachs points out that short-term market volatility may still remain high, but investors should continue to focus on the Chinese AI ecosystem.

In terms of configuration, investors can gradually allocate to H-share network and software technology stocks with valuations at the cycle low, as the losses of businesses such as online food delivery and instant delivery are gradually narrowed, and the momentum of cloud computing, AI intelligence, and token consumption is strengthened, and tactical investment value is increasing.

In addition, Goldman Sachs also looks favorably on policy beneficiaries in the AI and non-AI fields, including biotechnology, service consumption, advanced manufacturing, and agriculture, and recommends re-focusing on profit fundamentals, paying attention to growth stocks that were mistakenly killed in this correction but still have solid profit support, and continuing to dig up IPO market excess returns and shareholder return opportunities.

Overall, this AI correction and style rotation are starting to ease, but short-term volatility may still remain high; under the continued support of AI capital expenditures and fundamental trends, market focus is gradually shifting from 'all-out pursuit of AI' to re-selecting valuations, profits, and individual stock fundamentals.

items.title: 原相Q3營收估持平 無人載具、電競滑鼠扮動能
items.title_en: Original Sin Q3 Revenue Expected to Hold Steady, Autonomous Vehicles and Gaming Mice Drive Growth
paras: 原相 (3227-TW) 今 (11) 日召開法說會，展望第三季，財務長羅美煒表示，儘管一般滑鼠及遊戲機需求轉弱，但電競滑鼠需求持續成長，加上無人載具感測器動能強勁，預期第三季營收將與第二季大致持平，毛利率及營益率也可望維持穩定。
以各產品線來看，原相第三季整體滑鼠業績大致與上季相當或略優於上季，其中，電競滑鼠需求依舊熱絡，營收將較第二季成長，不過，一般滑鼠受到 PC、筆電終端市場需求疲弱影響，表現估較第二季下滑。
遊戲機方面，由於第二季基期較高，原相預期，第三季相關營收將較上季下滑；其他產品線表現則相對強勁，其中以無人載具相關標準感測器成長最明顯，需求持續暢旺，可望帶動其他產品線第三季營收較第二季進一步成長。
原相表示，無人載具相關應用不僅限於無人機，也涵蓋各類無人車及其他載具，目前相關產品營收占比已超過 10%，且自去年第四季以來，單季占比均維持在一成以上。公司看好無人載具市場後續發展，也將持續推出新產品並爭取更多客戶。
不過，隨著無人載具相關感測器占比提高，也對產品組合帶來一定影響。羅美煒指出，標準感測器市場競爭較為激烈，毛利率低於公司平均，因此第二季在相關產品快速成長下，整體毛利率由先前高檔回落至 58.2%。
展望第三季，公司預期滑鼠產品占比將略為增加，但標準感測器占比也將較第二季提高數個百分點，兩者影響互抵後，第三季毛利率預估與第二季大致相當，近期幾季毛利率不會有太大變化；營益率也預期維持與第二季相近水準。
成本方面，原相表示，目前部分晶圓產能仍偏緊，加上封裝原物料及貴金屬價格上漲，部分產品生產成本持續承壓，公司目前正與客戶溝通，希望適度反映成本增加。未來也將透過 12 吋晶圓製程、製程升級及增加晶圓與封測供應來源等方式，降低供應鏈壓力並維持毛利率穩定。
至於新產品布局，原相第二季 TDI 感測器已開始小量出貨給衛星客戶，目前營收占比仍低；AI 方面則聚焦 Edge AI 應用，包括具備 AI 功能的感測器產品持續推廣，盼未來逐步帶來營收貢獻。
paras_en: Original Sin (3227-TW) held a conference call today to discuss its third-quarter outlook, with CFO Lo Mei-wei stating that despite a decline in general mouse and gaming console demand, gaming mouse sales continue to grow, and the company expects third-quarter revenue to be roughly flat with the second quarter, with gross margin and operating margin also expected to remain stable.

Looking at individual product lines, Original Sin's third-quarter overall mouse business is expected to be roughly in line with or slightly better than the previous quarter, with gaming mouse sales continuing to be hot, and revenue expected to grow compared to the second quarter. However, general mouse sales are expected to decline due to weak demand in the PC and notebook terminal markets.

In terms of gaming consoles, Original Sin expects third-quarter revenue to decline from the previous quarter due to a high base in the second quarter. Other product lines are expected to perform relatively well, with standard sensors for autonomous vehicles growing the most, and demand remaining strong, which is expected to drive revenue growth in the third quarter compared to the second quarter.

Original Sin notes that the applications of autonomous vehicles are not limited to drones, but also include various types of autonomous vehicles and other vehicles, with related product revenue exceeding 10% and maintaining a single-digit percentage share in each quarter since the fourth quarter of last year. The company is optimistic about the development of the autonomous vehicle market and will continue to launch new products and pursue more customers.

However, as the proportion of standard sensors for autonomous vehicles increases, it also brings a certain impact to the product mix. Lo Mei-wei pointed out that the standard sensor market is highly competitive, with lower gross margins than the company's average, so in the second quarter, when related products grew rapidly, the overall gross margin fell to 58.2% from a previous high.

Looking ahead to the third quarter, the company expects the proportion of mouse products to increase slightly, but the proportion of standard sensors for autonomous vehicles is also expected to increase by several percentage points, with the two factors offsetting each other, resulting in a third-quarter gross margin estimate similar to the second quarter, with little change in gross margin over the past few quarters; operating margin is also expected to remain similar to the second quarter.

In terms of costs, Original Sin notes that some of its wafer production capacity is still tight, and with the increase in packaging materials and precious metal prices, the production costs of some products continue to be under pressure. The company is currently communicating with customers to reflect the increase in costs in a moderate manner. In the future, it will also reduce supply chain pressure and maintain stable gross margins through 12-inch wafer processes, process upgrades, and increased wafer and packaging supply sources.

As for new product layout, Original Sin's TDI sensor has begun small-scale shipments to satellite customers in the second quarter, with revenue share still low; in AI, the company focuses on Edge AI applications, including the continued promotion of sensor products with AI capabilities, hoping to contribute to revenue in the future.

items.title: 一卡通新董座由前高市府秘書長郭添貴接任、廖泰翔卸任
items.title_en: One Card's New Chairman Takes Office, Replacing Liao Tai-Xiang
paras: 一卡通票證公司今 (11) 日召開臨時董事會宣布，代理董事長廖泰翔將於 2026 年 8 月 11 日卸任，會中推舉通過自高雄市政府秘書長榮退的郭添貴擔任董事長，帶領一卡通公司開創支付應用新局。
一卡通新任董事長郭添貴表示，廖董事長自 2022 年 8 月 25 日上任以來，成功帶領一卡通在數位轉型與永續發展上取得顯著成就，並憑藉其豐富的市政與產業經驗、對市場趨勢的敏銳掌握及前瞻的策略視野，深化 iPASS 一卡通與各界合作，持續拓展支付應用場景與商業發展機會。
在廖的帶領下，iPASS 一卡通成功躍升為全台用戶數最多的電子支付品牌之一，用戶數突破 725 萬，成長 40%；儲值卡發行超過 5,400 萬張，成長約 33%。

廖泰翔表示，「一卡通公司近 3 年不僅在 iPASS MONEY 用戶數上有顯著成長，iPASS 一卡通整體營業額相較 2022 年更成長高達 79.2%，讓 iPASS 一卡通一舉成為橫跨全台交通、消費支付、生活繳費及社群轉帳四大場景，深受民眾青睞的支付領導品牌。」並以豐富多元的支付生態系為基礎，結合數據分析深化會員經營，協助政府與企業夥伴推動數位轉型，讓一卡通持續邁向「iPASS 一卡通 3.0」。

廖在任期間，除主導一卡通國內外支付版圖拓展，亦在數位轉型與永續發展上締造卓越成效。透過跨域整合，推動交通碳排放數據取得 BSI 認證，協助企業導入「ESG 差勤卡減碳方案」，更推出獨步市場的「一卡通綠點」回饋機制，鼓勵民眾透過日常消費與公共運輸實踐低碳生活，與政府推動 2050 淨零轉型目標相互呼應。廖董事長亦善用其對城市經濟發展的深入理解，成功促成一卡通與高雄市大型節慶活動結合，提升市集體驗並推動綠色經濟，展現企業與城市發展共榮的典範。

此外，在電子支付獨立發展上，「一卡通 iPASS MONEY」APP 成功整合儲值卡與電子支付功能，打造全方位行動支付平台。配合政府 TWQR 共用碼政策，「一卡通 iPASS MONEY」APP 全面串接相關服務，並積極協助推動交通乘車碼支付標準化；同時將支付服務觸角延伸至境外，支援日本 PayPay 跨境支付及外籍移工匯兌，展現一卡通推動策略合作與拓展市場的開放性及前瞻性。並於 115 年 1 月迎來重大里程碑，帶領團隊實現 iPASS MONEY 電子支付服務獨立營運，正式宣告 2026 年為一卡通「電支獨立元年」，全面開啟自主、穩健且多元的數位金融新局。
新任董事長將由前高雄市政府秘書長郭添貴接任。郭歷任交通部航港局局長、台灣港務公司總經理、高雄港區土地開發公司董事長及高市府文化局副局長等要職，公職歷練完整，熟稔政府法規、人事及機關運作，有助於推動社會福利、公共運輸、減碳永續、公衛保健、場館展演、商圈行銷、規費繳納等領域之儲值卡與電子支付帳戶業務整合及健全發展。
郭添貴於交通部、港區土地開發公司、高雄流行音樂中心等機構擔任要職期間，累積豐富的中央資源協調、商業場域經營，以及文化展演結合經濟活動等經驗；公職任內更曾協調府內局處協助亞洲資產管理中心高雄專區設立。其完整歷練將有助於一卡通加速跨域合作、擴大使用場景、整合公私部門資源，並進一步擘劃具前瞻性的金融商品與創新服務。
一卡通票證公司未來將借重郭添貴豐富的跨領域治理與產業經驗，持續提升品牌影響力，讓 iPASS 一卡通在智慧城市、金融創新及永續發展等領域扮演不可或缺的重要角色，持續朝成為支付基礎建設的目標邁進，深耕台灣多元支付市場。

items.title: 0050、0056、006208配息怎麼領更划算？ETF投資人必看的省稅4大招
paras: 2026 年台股進入除權息旺季，0050、0056、006208 等大型 ETF 配息受到市場關注。不過，ETF 公告的每股配息金額，並不等於投資人最終實際入帳的金額，配息來源、所得類別及二代健保補充保費，都可能影響實領金額。本文整理三檔熱門 ETF 近期配息資訊，從配息組成、補充保費計算，到不同 ETF 配息政策對投資人的影響，帶投資人掌握「領息」之外，更容易被忽略的稅費細節。
* 本文彙整公開資訊僅供參考，實際配息及所得類別應以基金公司公告與投資人實際收到之收益分配通知書為準；投資人投資前應審慎評估自身需求及投資風險。
隨著除權息旺季到來，台灣超過 600 萬名 ETF 受益人正密切關注配息動態。元大台灣 50（0050）、元大高股息（0056）與富邦台 50（006208）這三檔國民 ETF 於 8 月 10 日同步配息，成為市場焦點。
以下整理本次配息關鍵數據：
從三檔 ETF 的設計來看，0050 與 006208 皆以大型市值股為主要投資方向，0056 則以高股息策略為核心。因此，投資人比較 ETF 時，不宜只看「每股配多少」，還應進一步觀察配息頻率、配息來源、基金投資策略及長期總報酬
ETF 配息為什麼可能被扣二代健保？關鍵在所得類別
■ 更多完整介紹請見：豐雲學堂存股怎麼買專欄
二、持有多少 ETF 可能碰到補充保費門檻？
由於 ETF 每期配息來源與所得類別可能不同，同一檔 ETF 不同次配息的計費基礎也可能有所差異，因此「買幾張會被扣補充保費」並沒有固定答案。
以本次配息資料進行估算：
上述數據僅為依本次配息結構進行的試算，並不代表未來每次配息均適用相同結果。
尤其 ETF 配息組成會隨市場環境、基金收益及收益分配政策變動，因此投資人若要確認實際扣繳情形，仍應以基金公司公布的收益分配通知書及相關扣繳資料為準。
■ 更多完整介紹請見：豐雲學堂存股怎麼買專欄
三、想降低領息稅費影響？先看「配息政策」而非只追高殖利率
對於重視現金流的投資人而言，高配息並不代表一定能提高最終投資報酬；同樣地，較低或不配息的 ETF 也不代表投資成本一定比較低。
如果投資目標是長期累積資產，可以從以下幾個方向比較：
1. 評估不配息型 ETF
部分 ETF 採取不配息設計，將相關收益留在基金內反映於淨值。以 009816 為例，其採不配息設計，投資人不會因現金配息而產生相應的股利所得入帳。
對於以資產累積為主要目標的投資人而言，不配息設計可以降低現金流進出的頻率，也有利於持續累積資產。
不過，不配息並不代表「完全沒有稅務成本」，投資人仍應從 ETF 投資架構、總報酬、費用及稅制等面向綜合評估。
2. 留意配息組成
ETF 公告配息時，投資人除了看每股配息金額，也可以進一步查看收益分配組成。
不同所得來源可能涉及不同的課稅及補充保費規定，因此比較 ETF 時，建議將「配多少」與「配的是什麼」分開觀察。
在比較 0050、0056、006208 等不同策略 ETF 時，建議從三個層次觀察：
第一，看投資目標。
若希望累積資產，可以優先比較市值型 ETF 的長期成長能力；若有現金流需求，則可進一步評估高股息 ETF。
第二，看總報酬。
除了股息，也應將 ETF 價格變化、配息及相關成本納入考量，而非單看單次配息金額。
第三，看稅費與個人需求。
相同的 ETF，對不同所得水準、投資期限及現金流需求的投資人，實際效益可能不同。
因此，投資人選擇 ETF 時，與其追逐「哪一檔配最多」，不如先確認自身投資目的，再比較 ETF 的投資策略、長期報酬、配息政策與稅費影響。
以永豐金證券為例，大戶投 APP 提供整股、零股等交易方式，投資人可依自身資金條件及投資策略選擇適合的方式；豐存股提供台股 100 元起、美股 10 美元起的定期定額投資門檻，讓投資人可以透過固定投入建立長期投資紀律。

items.title: 比亞迪兩周拿下1,000張訂單 闖入日本車廠最熟悉戰場
items.title_en: BYD Secures 1,000 Orders in Two Weeks, Enters Japan's K-car Market
paras: 比亞迪 (002594-CN) 進入日本乘用車市場三年半，存在感依然有限。2025 年這家全球新能源車銷量冠軍在日本僅售出 3,742 輛新車，佔整體新車市場不足 0.1%。
比亞迪沒有選擇離場，而是將下一張牌打進了日本汽車企業最熟悉、也最難被外來者撬動的 K-car 市場。2026 年 7 月，比亞迪推出海獺（RACCO），第一次按照日本當地市場規則和消費者使用習慣，量身打造了一款產品。
據《界面新聞》報導，比亞迪日本官網 10 日（周一）表示，海獺上市約兩周，累計訂單已突破 1,000 輛，約八成訂單來自頂配版本。這一成績相當於其今年 1 萬輛訂單目標 10%，接近比亞迪 2026 年上半年在日新車登記量一半。
訂單量並不等同於最終交付數據，但對一家 2025 年平均每月在日本只掛牌約 312 輛新車的企業而言，海獺開局不同尋常。它至少表明，比亞迪終於找到一款能夠讓更多日本消費者進店體驗的車型。
比亞迪海獺瞄准的 K-car 市場，是日本汽車消費的基本盤。道路狹窄、用車成本較高，加上長期稅費優惠和政策扶持，帶動這類車型在日本逐步普及。
日本汽車工業協會的數據顯示，2025 年日本 K-car 約銷量約 166.73 萬輛，約佔日本新車市場三至四成，全日本平均每 100 戶家庭擁有約 55 輛 K-car。它廣泛承擔家庭通勤、買菜、購物等日常出行需求。
這是一個外資品牌幾乎存在感為零的市場。利潤較薄，渠道投入較高，外資汽車品牌缺乏商業動力。本田、鈴木、大發、日產等日本本土汽車企業長期是這一細分市場的主導玩家。
比亞迪選擇的突破口，是 K-car 市場中仍處於早期階段的純電市場。目前日本純電 K-car 的選擇不多，主流車型主要包括日產 Sakura、三菱 eK X EV 和本田 N-ONE e。
與此同時，日本部分地方人口持續減少，加油站不斷撤併，但這些地區獨棟住宅比例較高，安裝家庭充電設施相對方便。燃油補給便利性下降，加上較為成熟的家庭充電條件，為純電 K-car 創造了潛在需求。
一位下定大阪車主表示，家裡已經安裝了充電樁，海獺的續航足以覆蓋日常出行，省錢又方便。
據《日本經濟新聞》報導，一名金澤比亞迪門市人員說，幾乎沒有消費者在海獺與日產 Sakura 之間做選擇，他們更常糾結的是購買一輛傳統燃油輕型車，還是首次嘗試純電車型。
paras_en: BYD (002594-CN) has been present in Japan's passenger car market for three and a half years, but its presence is still limited. In 2025, the world's leading new energy vehicle sales champion sold only 3,742 new cars in Japan, accounting for less than 0.1% of the country's total new car market.

Instead of withdrawing, BYD has chosen to enter Japan's K-car market, which is the most familiar and difficult to penetrate for foreign brands. In July 2026, BYD launched the Raccoon (海獺), its first product tailored to Japan's local market rules and consumer habits.

According to Interface News, BYD's Japanese website announced on Monday that the Raccoon had accumulated over 1,000 orders in about two weeks since its launch, with about 80% of the orders being for the top-of-the-line version. This achievement accounts for 10% of BYD's 100,000-unit sales target for this year and is close to the company's 50% of new car registrations in Japan in the first half of 2026.

While the number of orders does not directly translate to final delivery data, it is a significant achievement for a company that averaged only about 312 new car sales per month in Japan in 2025. It at least suggests that BYD has found a model that can attract more Japanese consumers to visit its stores.

The K-car market, which BYD's Raccoon is targeting, is Japan's basic market for automotive consumption. Narrow roads, high vehicle costs, and long-term tax incentives and policy support have driven the popularity of this type of vehicle in Japan.

Data from the Japan Automobile Manufacturers Association shows that Japan's K-car sales in 2025 reached approximately 1.67 million units, accounting for about 30-40% of the country's new car market. On average, every 100 households in Japan own about 55 K-cars, which widely bear the burden of daily commuting, grocery shopping, and other daily travel needs.

This is a market where foreign brands have almost zero presence. The profit margins are thin, and the channel investment is high, making it difficult for foreign automakers to have the commercial motivation to enter this market. Honda, Suzuki, Daihatsu, and Nissan, Japan's domestic automakers, have long been the dominant players in this sub-market.

BYD has chosen to break into the K-car market through the pure electric market, which is still in its early stages. Currently, the choices for pure electric K-cars in Japan are limited, with mainstream models including the Nissan Sakura, Mitsubishi eK X EV, and Honda N-ONE e.

At the same time, Japan's population in some areas continues to decline, and gas stations are being consolidated, but these areas have a higher proportion of single-family homes, making it relatively easy to install home charging facilities. As fuel supply convenience decreases and home charging conditions become more mature, it creates potential demand for pure electric K-cars.
A car owner in Osaka said that his family has already installed a charging station at home, and the Raccoon's range is sufficient to cover daily travel, saving money and being convenient.

According to a report by the Nikkei Shimbun, a salesperson at a BYD dealership in Kanazawa said that almost no consumers are choosing between the Raccoon and the Nissan Sakura, but rather are deciding whether to buy a traditional gasoline-powered lightweight car or try a pure electric car for the first time.

items.title: 中嘉寬頻攜手1Finity、辰隆科技 完成400G APN全光網路部署
items.title_en: Chunghwa Telecom Completes 400G APN All-Optical Network Deployment with 1Finity and DCH Technology
paras: 中嘉寬頻今 (11 日) 宣布，攜富士通集團旗下負責網路事業的 1Finity 股份有限公司及其台灣技術服務夥伴「辰隆科技」，於中嘉寬頻的商用網路環境中導入「1Finity Ultra Optical System 光傳輸系統」，正式完成 400G APN 全光網路部署，此架構可兼容 800G 光通訊，為後續網路擴充與新服務發展預留彈性，以因應 AI 時代的數位基礎建設剛需。
此次合作是中嘉寬頻布局全光網路的重要里程碑，也是邁向 AI 世代網路基礎建設的關鍵一步。第一階段導入「1Finity Ultra Optical System 光傳輸解決方案」，以全光傳輸（All-Photonics）與光交換（Photonic Switching）為核心，打造端對端高速傳輸架構。
相較於傳統網路架構，APN 具備高頻寬、低延遲、高可靠性及高度擴充性等優勢，可望帶來傳輸容量提升 5 至 20 倍、網路延遲降低 50% 至 90%、以及能源效率提升 30% 至 60% 等效益，不僅能滿足當前 AI 運算、資料中心互連（DCI）及雲端服務需求，更提前為 1.2Tbps、1.6Tbps 等下一世代超高速傳輸能力預留升級空間，展現中嘉寬頻持續引領台灣全光網路技術發展的前瞻布局。
另一方面，除了效能全面升級，APN 亦兼顧永續發展需求，透過降低網路設備耗能、提升光傳輸效率與整體資源利用率，可有效減少資料中心及網路基礎設施的碳排放，協助企業在加速 AI 創新與數位轉型的同時，兼顧 ESG 治理、淨零減碳及永續營運目標，打造兼具高效能與低碳化的新世代數位基礎建設。
中嘉集團總經理陳佐銘表示，AI 浪潮加速推動全球數位轉型，也重新定義網路的價值，從單純的資訊傳輸管道，成為驅動產業創新與升級的關鍵基礎設施，更是支撐 AI 運算、資料中心互連、智慧城市及國家數位韌性的核心基石。
陳佐銘指出，此次中嘉寬頻率先完成具備 800G APN 服務能力的商用全光網路部署，不僅代表網路技術的重大升級，更是布局新世代數位基礎建設的重要里程碑。我們期待透過更高速、更智慧、更具韌性的網路，協助加速 AI 應用落地，同時並兼顧節能減碳與永續發展，實現科技創新與 ESG 並進，為台灣打造更具韌性的數位基礎建設，在全球 AI 與綠色轉型浪潮中建立數位競爭力與永續發展優勢。
paras_en: Chunghwa Telecom today announced that it has completed the deployment of its 400G APN all-optical network with 1Finity, a subsidiary of Fujitsu Group, and its Taiwanese technology partner DCH Technology. The 1Finity Ultra Optical System transmission system has been introduced in Chunghwa Telecom's commercial network environment, marking the completion of the 400G APN all-optical network deployment.

This collaboration is an important milestone in Chunghwa Telecom's layout of all-optical networks and a crucial step towards building AI-era network infrastructure. The first phase of the deployment involves introducing the 1Finity Ultra Optical System solution, which is based on all-optical transmission (All-Photonics) and photonic switching (Photonic Switching) as its core, to create an end-to-end high-speed transmission framework.

Compared to traditional network architectures, APN offers advantages such as high bandwidth, low latency, high reliability, and high scalability. It is expected to bring about a 5- to 20-fold increase in transmission capacity, a 50% to 90% reduction in network latency, and a 30% to 60% improvement in energy efficiency. Not only can it meet the current demands of AI computing, data center interconnection (DCI), and cloud services, but it also reserves upgrade space for next-generation ultra-high-speed transmission capabilities such as 1.2Tbps and 1.6Tbps, showcasing Chunghwa Telecom's forward-looking layout in Taiwan's all-optical network technology development.

On the other hand, in addition to overall performance upgrades, APN also considers the needs of sustainable development. By reducing network device energy consumption, improving light transmission efficiency, and enhancing overall resource utilization rates, it can effectively reduce carbon emissions from data centers and network infrastructure, helping enterprises accelerate AI innovation and digital transformation while meeting ESG governance, net-zero carbon, and sustainable operation goals, creating a new generation of high-performance and low-carbon digital infrastructure.

Chunghwa Group CEO Chen Zuo-ming said that the AI wave has accelerated global digital transformation and redefined the value of networks, from a simple information transmission pipeline to a critical infrastructure driving industry innovation and upgrading, and supporting AI computing, data center interconnection, smart cities, and national digital resilience.

Chen Zuo-ming pointed out that this time, Chunghwa Telecom has completed the commercial deployment of a 400G APN service-capable all-optical network, representing a major upgrade in network technology and an important milestone in laying out new-generation digital infrastructure. We expect to accelerate the landing of AI applications through faster, smarter, and more resilient networks, while also considering energy savings and carbon reduction, and achieving technological innovation and ESG progress, to create a more resilient digital infrastructure for Taiwan and establish digital competitiveness and sustainable development advantages in the global AI and green transformation wave.

items.title: Fed升息壓力大降 金價突破4400美元 黃金、白銀ETF強勁反彈
items.title_en: Fed Rate Hike Pressure Eases, Gold Price Breaks Through $4,400
paras: 美國非農就業指數低於預期，引發市場預期 Fed 升息機率大降，國際金價突破 4,400 美元 / 盎司大關，創下 9 周新高。國內貴金屬 ETF 表現強勁，今 (11) 日期元大 S&P 黃金正 2 (00708L-TW)、期元大 S&P 黃金 (00635U-TW)、期元大道瓊白銀 (00738U-TW) 再度連袂上漲，8 月以來漲幅已突破雙位數。
台股今 (11) 日盤整重返 45,000 點，貴金屬 ETF 則受惠升息疑慮暫緩，表現連日走升，00708L、00635U 與 00738U 於 7 月 FOMC 會議後，分別強漲 17.4%、8.6%、13.5%。
法人分析，美元轉弱以及避險需求回升，帶動黃金重新獲得買盤支撐。近期市場對進一步升息預期降溫，加上全球經濟成長與地緣政治不確定性仍高，使黃金避險屬性持續受到青睞；白銀價格則受惠於貴金屬投資氛圍轉佳，以及工業需求前景改善，同步黃金上漲。
雖上半年黃金表現承壓，但在 4,000 美元 / 盎司獲得強勁支撐，反映在全球不確定性仍高的環境下，黃金作為資產配置工具的價值依然受到市場重視，包括全球央行持續增持黃金的趨勢未見改變。其中，中國央行 7 月增持黃金約 64 萬盎司，連續 21 個月加碼，儲備量更是創下 2023 年 10 月以來新高。
在多重利多不變下，摩根大通預測金價有望 2026 年第四季突破 5,000 美元 / 盎司；華爾街指標造市商城堡證券也積極看漲，指出目前趨勢交易資金在黃金、白銀呈現淨空頭，一旦行情向上突破將帶動回補買盤，推升漲勢。

paras_en: The US non-farm employment index fell short of expectations, leading to a decline in the probability of a Fed rate hike, causing international gold prices to break through the $4,400 per ounce barrier, reaching a new high in 9 weeks. Domestic precious metal ETFs performed strongly, with S&P Gold (00708L-TW) and S&P Gold (00635U-TW) and S&P Silver (00738U-TW) rising again today, with an 8-month gain exceeding double digits.

The TAIEX returned to 45,000 points today, while precious metal ETFs benefited from the temporary easing of rate hike concerns, with 00708L, 00635U, and 00738U rising by 17.4%, 8.6%, and 13.5% respectively since the July FOMC meeting.

Analysts believe that the weakening dollar and the resurgence of risk aversion demand have driven gold to regain buying support. Market expectations of further rate hikes have cooled down recently, and the uncertainty of global economic growth and geopolitics remains high, making gold a preferred safe-haven asset; silver prices, on the other hand, have benefited from the improved investment environment for precious metals and the improved outlook for industrial demand, coinciding with the rise in gold prices.

Although gold prices were under pressure in the first half of the year, they have found strong support at $4,000 per ounce, reflecting the continued importance of gold as an asset allocation tool in a world where uncertainty remains high. This is evident in the continued trend of central banks increasing their gold holdings, including China's People's Bank of China, which added approximately 640,000 ounces in July, marking the 21st consecutive month of gold purchases, with reserves reaching a new high since October 2023.

Despite the multiple bullish factors, Morgan Stanley predicts that gold prices may break through $5,000 per ounce in the fourth quarter of 2026; Castle Securities, a market maker on Wall Street, is also optimistic, pointing out that the trend of net short positions in gold and silver is currently strong, and that a breakout to the upside will trigger a rebound in buying interest, driving the price higher.

items.title: 原相Q3營收估持平 無人載具、電競滑鼠扮動能
items.title_en: Original Sin Q3 Revenue Expected to Hold Steady, Autonomous Vehicles and Gaming Mice Drive Growth
paras: 原相 (3227-TW) 今 (11) 日召開法說會，展望第三季，財務長羅美煒表示，儘管一般滑鼠及遊戲機需求轉弱，但電競滑鼠需求持續成長，加上無人載具感測器動能強勁，預期第三季營收將與第二季大致持平，毛利率及營益率也可望維持穩定。
以各產品線來看，原相第三季整體滑鼠業績大致與上季相當或略優於上季，其中，電競滑鼠需求依舊熱絡，營收將較第二季成長，不過，一般滑鼠受到 PC、筆電終端市場需求疲弱影響，表現估較第二季下滑。
遊戲機方面，由於第二季基期較高，原相預期，第三季相關營收將較上季下滑；其他產品線表現則相對強勁，其中以無人載具相關標準感測器成長最明顯，需求持續暢旺，可望帶動其他產品線第三季營收較第二季進一步成長。
原相表示，無人載具相關應用不僅限於無人機，也涵蓋各類無人車及其他載具，目前相關產品營收占比已超過 10%，且自去年第四季以來，單季占比均維持在一成以上。公司看好無人載具市場後續發展，也將持續推出新產品並爭取更多客戶。
不過，隨著無人載具相關感測器占比提高，也對產品組合帶來一定影響。羅美煒指出，標準感測器市場競爭較為激烈，毛利率低於公司平均，因此第二季在相關產品快速成長下，整體毛利率由先前高檔回落至 58.2%。
展望第三季，公司預期滑鼠產品占比將略為增加，但標準感測器占比也將較第二季提高數個百分點，兩者影響互抵後，第三季毛利率預估與第二季大致相當，近期幾季毛利率不會有太大變化；營益率也預期維持與第二季相近水準。
成本方面，原相表示，目前部分晶圓產能仍偏緊，加上封裝原物料及貴金屬價格上漲，部分產品生產成本持續承壓，公司目前正與客戶溝通，希望適度反映成本增加。未來也將透過 12 吋晶圓製程、製程升級及增加晶圓與封測供應來源等方式，降低供應鏈壓力並維持毛利率穩定。
至於新產品布局，原相第二季 TDI 感測器已開始小量出貨給衛星客戶，目前營收占比仍低；AI 方面則聚焦 Edge AI 應用，包括具備 AI 功能的感測器產品持續推廣，盼未來逐步帶來營收貢獻。
paras_en: Original Sin (3227-TW) held a conference call today to discuss its third-quarter outlook, with CFO Lo Mei-wei stating that despite a decline in general mouse and gaming console demand, gaming mouse sales continue to grow, and the company expects third-quarter revenue to be roughly flat with the second quarter, with gross margin and operating margin also expected to remain stable.

Looking at individual product lines, Original Sin's third-quarter overall mouse business is expected to be roughly in line with or slightly better than the previous quarter, with gaming mouse sales continuing to be hot, and revenue expected to grow compared to the second quarter. However, general mouse sales are expected to decline due to weak demand in the PC and notebook terminal markets.

In terms of gaming consoles, Original Sin expects third-quarter revenue to decline from the previous quarter due to a high base in the second quarter. Other product lines are expected to perform relatively well, with standard sensors for autonomous vehicles growing the most, and demand remaining strong, which is expected to drive revenue growth in the third quarter compared to the second quarter.

Original Sin notes that the applications of autonomous vehicles are not limited to drones, but also include various types of autonomous vehicles and other vehicles, with related product revenue exceeding 10% and maintaining a single-digit percentage share in each quarter since the fourth quarter of last year. The company is optimistic about the development of the autonomous vehicle market and will continue to launch new products and pursue more customers.

However, as the proportion of standard sensors for autonomous vehicles increases, it also brings a certain impact to the product mix. Lo Mei-wei pointed out that the standard sensor market is highly competitive, with lower gross margins than the company's average, so in the second quarter, when related products grew rapidly, the overall gross margin fell to 58.2% from a previous high.

Looking ahead to the third quarter, the company expects the proportion of mouse products to increase slightly, but the proportion of standard sensors for autonomous vehicles is also expected to increase by several percentage points, with the two factors offsetting each other, resulting in a third-quarter gross margin estimate similar to the second quarter, with little change in gross margin over the past few quarters; operating margin is also expected to remain similar to the second quarter.

In terms of costs, Original Sin notes that some of its wafer production capacity is still tight, and with the increase in packaging materials and precious metal prices, the production costs of some products continue to be under pressure. The company is currently communicating with customers to reflect the increase in costs in a moderate manner. In the future, it will also reduce supply chain pressure and maintain stable gross margins through 12-inch wafer processes, process upgrades, and increased wafer and packaging supply sources.

As for new product layout, Original Sin's TDI sensor has begun small-scale shipments to satellite customers in the second quarter, with revenue share still low; in AI, the company focuses on Edge AI applications, including the continued promotion of sensor products with AI capabilities, hoping to contribute to revenue in the future.

items.title: 一卡通新董座由前高市府秘書長郭添貴接任、廖泰翔卸任
items.title_en: One Card's New Chairman Takes Office, Replacing Liao Tai-Xiang
paras: 一卡通票證公司今 (11) 日召開臨時董事會宣布，代理董事長廖泰翔將於 2026 年 8 月 11 日卸任，會中推舉通過自高雄市政府秘書長榮退的郭添貴擔任董事長，帶領一卡通公司開創支付應用新局。
一卡通新任董事長郭添貴表示，廖董事長自 2022 年 8 月 25 日上任以來，成功帶領一卡通在數位轉型與永續發展上取得顯著成就，並憑藉其豐富的市政與產業經驗、對市場趨勢的敏銳掌握及前瞻的策略視野，深化 iPASS 一卡通與各界合作，持續拓展支付應用場景與商業發展機會。
在廖的帶領下，iPASS 一卡通成功躍升為全台用戶數最多的電子支付品牌之一，用戶數突破 725 萬，成長 40%；儲值卡發行超過 5,400 萬張，成長約 33%。

廖泰翔表示，「一卡通公司近 3 年不僅在 iPASS MONEY 用戶數上有顯著成長，iPASS 一卡通整體營業額相較 2022 年更成長高達 79.2%，讓 iPASS 一卡通一舉成為橫跨全台交通、消費支付、生活繳費及社群轉帳四大場景，深受民眾青睞的支付領導品牌。」並以豐富多元的支付生態系為基礎，結合數據分析深化會員經營，協助政府與企業夥伴推動數位轉型，讓一卡通持續邁向「iPASS 一卡通 3.0」。

廖在任期間，除主導一卡通國內外支付版圖拓展，亦在數位轉型與永續發展上締造卓越成效。透過跨域整合，推動交通碳排放數據取得 BSI 認證，協助企業導入「ESG 差勤卡減碳方案」，更推出獨步市場的「一卡通綠點」回饋機制，鼓勵民眾透過日常消費與公共運輸實踐低碳生活，與政府推動 2050 淨零轉型目標相互呼應。廖董事長亦善用其對城市經濟發展的深入理解，成功促成一卡通與高雄市大型節慶活動結合，提升市集體驗並推動綠色經濟，展現企業與城市發展共榮的典範。

此外，在電子支付獨立發展上，「一卡通 iPASS MONEY」APP 成功整合儲值卡與電子支付功能，打造全方位行動支付平台。配合政府 TWQR 共用碼政策，「一卡通 iPASS MONEY」APP 全面串接相關服務，並積極協助推動交通乘車碼支付標準化；同時將支付服務觸角延伸至境外，支援日本 PayPay 跨境支付及外籍移工匯兌，展現一卡通推動策略合作與拓展市場的開放性及前瞻性。並於 115 年 1 月迎來重大里程碑，帶領團隊實現 iPASS MONEY 電子支付服務獨立營運，正式宣告 2026 年為一卡通「電支獨立元年」，全面開啟自主、穩健且多元的數位金融新局。
新任董事長將由前高雄市政府秘書長郭添貴接任。郭歷任交通部航港局局長、台灣港務公司總經理、高雄港區土地開發公司董事長及高市府文化局副局長等要職，公職歷練完整，熟稔政府法規、人事及機關運作，有助於推動社會福利、公共運輸、減碳永續、公衛保健、場館展演、商圈行銷、規費繳納等領域之儲值卡與電子支付帳戶業務整合及健全發展。
郭添貴於交通部、港區土地開發公司、高雄流行音樂中心等機構擔任要職期間，累積豐富的中央資源協調、商業場域經營，以及文化展演結合經濟活動等經驗；公職任內更曾協調府內局處協助亞洲資產管理中心高雄專區設立。其完整歷練將有助於一卡通加速跨域合作、擴大使用場景、整合公私部門資源，並進一步擘劃具前瞻性的金融商品與創新服務。
一卡通票證公司未來將借重郭添貴豐富的跨領域治理與產業經驗，持續提升品牌影響力，讓 iPASS 一卡通在智慧城市、金融創新及永續發展等領域扮演不可或缺的重要角色，持續朝成為支付基礎建設的目標邁進，深耕台灣多元支付市場。
paras_en: One Card Co., Ltd. held an emergency board meeting today (August 11, 2026) and announced that proxy chairman Liao Tai-Xiang will resign on August 11, 2026. The meeting elected former Kaohsiung City Government Secretary-General Guo Tian-Kei to take over as chairman, leading One Card Co. to create a new era of payment applications.

One Card's new chairman, Guo Tian-Kei, stated that Liao, chairman since August 25, 2022, has achieved significant success in digital transformation and sustainable development, leveraging his rich experience in municipal and industry affairs, keen market trend awareness, and forward-looking strategic vision to deepen One Card's collaboration with various sectors, expand payment application scenarios, and business development opportunities.

Under Liao's leadership, One Card's iPASS has become one of the most popular electronic payment brands in Taiwan, with over 7.25 million users, a 40% increase; over 54 million stored-value cards issued, a 33% increase.

Liao stated, 'In the past three years, One Card has not only seen significant growth in iPASS MONEY users, but its overall revenue has increased by 79.2% compared to 2022, making One Card a leading payment brand that spans four major scenarios: transportation, consumption, life payments, and social transfers.' He further emphasized the importance of a diverse payment ecosystem, combining data analysis to deepen member engagement, assist government and corporate partners in driving digital transformation, and propel One Card towards 'iPASS One Card 3.0'.

During his tenure, Liao has led One Card's expansion of its payment landscape both domestically and internationally, and has achieved outstanding results in digital transformation and sustainable development. Through cross-domain integration, he has promoted the certification of transportation carbon emissions data by BSI, assisted companies in introducing 'ESG Time-Off Card Carbon Reduction Scheme', and launched the market-leading 'One Card Green Points' reward mechanism, encouraging citizens to practice low-carbon lifestyles through daily consumption and public transportation, aligning with the government's goal of achieving net-zero by 2050.

Liao has also leveraged his deep understanding of urban economic development to successfully integrate One Card with Kaohsiung's large-scale festival activities, enhancing the city's experience and promoting green economy, showcasing a model of corporate and urban development synergy.

Furthermore, in the development of electronic payments, 'One Card iPASS MONEY' APP has successfully integrated stored-value cards and electronic payment functions, creating a comprehensive mobile payment platform. In line with the government's TWQR shared code policy, 'One Card iPASS MONEY' APP has fully connected related services and actively assisted in promoting standardized transportation and ride-hailing code payments; meanwhile, it has extended payment services to overseas markets, supporting Japan's PayPay cross-border payments and foreign workers' remittances, demonstrating One Card's open and forward-looking strategy and market expansion.

In January 2026, One Card achieved a significant milestone, leading the team to achieve independent operation of iPASS MONEY electronic payment services, officially declaring 2026 as One Card's 'Year of Independent Operations', marking the beginning of a new era of autonomous, stable, and diverse digital finance.

The new chairman will be former Kaohsiung City Government Secretary-General Guo Tian-Kei. Guo has held various key positions, including Director-General of the Ministry of Transportation and Communications' Port Bureau, CEO of Taiwan Port Corporation, Chairman of Kaohsiung Port Area Development Corporation, and Deputy Director of Kaohsiung City Cultural Affairs Bureau, accumulating rich experience in coordinating central resources, commercial domain operation, and cultural performance integration, as well as experience in coordinating government agencies to assist the establishment of the Asian Asset Management Center's Kaohsiung Special Zone.

items.title: 0050、0056、006208配息怎麼領更划算？ETF投資人必看的省稅4大招
paras: 2026 年台股進入除權息旺季，0050、0056、006208 等大型 ETF 配息受到市場關注。不過，ETF 公告的每股配息金額，並不等於投資人最終實際入帳的金額，配息來源、所得類別及二代健保補充保費，都可能影響實領金額。本文整理三檔熱門 ETF 近期配息資訊，從配息組成、補充保費計算，到不同 ETF 配息政策對投資人的影響，帶投資人掌握「領息」之外，更容易被忽略的稅費細節。
* 本文彙整公開資訊僅供參考，實際配息及所得類別應以基金公司公告與投資人實際收到之收益分配通知書為準；投資人投資前應審慎評估自身需求及投資風險。
隨著除權息旺季到來，台灣超過 600 萬名 ETF 受益人正密切關注配息動態。元大台灣 50（0050）、元大高股息（0056）與富邦台 50（006208）這三檔國民 ETF 於 8 月 10 日同步配息，成為市場焦點。
以下整理本次配息關鍵數據：
從三檔 ETF 的設計來看，0050 與 006208 皆以大型市值股為主要投資方向，0056 則以高股息策略為核心。因此，投資人比較 ETF 時，不宜只看「每股配多少」，還應進一步觀察配息頻率、配息來源、基金投資策略及長期總報酬
ETF 配息為什麼可能被扣二代健保？關鍵在所得類別
■ 更多完整介紹請見：豐雲學堂存股怎麼買專欄
二、持有多少 ETF 可能碰到補充保費門檻？
由於 ETF 每期配息來源與所得類別可能不同，同一檔 ETF 不同次配息的計費基礎也可能有所差異，因此「買幾張會被扣補充保費」並沒有固定答案。
以本次配息資料進行估算：
上述數據僅為依本次配息結構進行的試算，並不代表未來每次配息均適用相同結果。
尤其 ETF 配息組成會隨市場環境、基金收益及收益分配政策變動，因此投資人若要確認實際扣繳情形，仍應以基金公司公布的收益分配通知書及相關扣繳資料為準。
■ 更多完整介紹請見：豐雲學堂存股怎麼買專欄
三、想降低領息稅費影響？先看「配息政策」而非只追高殖利率
對於重視現金流的投資人而言，高配息並不代表一定能提高最終投資報酬；同樣地，較低或不配息的 ETF 也不代表投資成本一定比較低。
如果投資目標是長期累積資產，可以從以下幾個方向比較：
1. 評估不配息型 ETF
部分 ETF 採取不配息設計，將相關收益留在基金內反映於淨值。以 009816 為例，其採不配息設計，投資人不會因現金配息而產生相應的股利所得入帳。
對於以資產累積為主要目標的投資人而言，不配息設計可以降低現金流進出的頻率，也有利於持續累積資產。
不過，不配息並不代表「完全沒有稅務成本」，投資人仍應從 ETF 投資架構、總報酬、費用及稅制等面向綜合評估。
2. 留意配息組成
ETF 公告配息時，投資人除了看每股配息金額，也可以進一步查看收益分配組成。
不同所得來源可能涉及不同的課稅及補充保費規定，因此比較 ETF 時，建議將「配多少」與「配的是什麼」分開觀察。
在比較 0050、0056、006208 等不同策略 ETF 時，建議從三個層次觀察：
第一，看投資目標。

items.title: 中嘉寬頻攜手1Finity、辰隆科技 完成400G APN全光網路部署
items.title_en: Chunghwa Telecom Completes 400G APN All-Optical Network Deployment with 1Finity and DCH Technology
paras: 中嘉寬頻今 (11 日) 宣布，攜富士通集團旗下負責網路事業的 1Finity 股份有限公司及其台灣技術服務夥伴「辰隆科技」，於中嘉寬頻的商用網路環境中導入「1Finity Ultra Optical System 光傳輸系統」，正式完成 400G APN 全光網路部署，此架構可兼容 800G 光通訊，為後續網路擴充與新服務發展預留彈性，以因應 AI 時代的數位基礎建設剛需。
此次合作是中嘉寬頻布局全光網路的重要里程碑，也是邁向 AI 世代網路基礎建設的關鍵一步。第一階段導入「1Finity Ultra Optical System 光傳輸解決方案」，以全光傳輸（All-Photonics）與光交換（Photonic Switching）為核心，打造端對端高速傳輸架構。
相較於傳統網路架構，APN 具備高頻寬、低延遲、高可靠性及高度擴充性等優勢，可望帶來傳輸容量提升 5 至 20 倍、網路延遲降低 50% 至 90%、以及能源效率提升 30% 至 60% 等效益，不僅能滿足當前 AI 運算、資料中心互連（DCI）及雲端服務需求，更提前為 1.2Tbps、1.6Tbps 等下一世代超高速傳輸能力預留升級空間，展現中嘉寬頻持續引領台灣全光網路技術發展的前瞻布局。
另一方面，除了效能全面升級，APN 亦兼顧永續發展需求，透過降低網路設備耗能、提升光傳輸效率與整體資源利用率，可有效減少資料中心及網路基礎設施的碳排放，協助企業在加速 AI 創新與數位轉型的同時，兼顧 ESG 治理、淨零減碳及永續營運目標，打造兼具高效能與低碳化的新世代數位基礎建設。
中嘉集團總經理陳佐銘表示，AI 浪潮加速推動全球數位轉型，也重新定義網路的價值，從單純的資訊傳輸管道，成為驅動產業創新與升級的關鍵基礎設施，更是支撐 AI 運算、資料中心互連、智慧城市及國家數位韌性的核心基石。
陳佐銘指出，此次中嘉寬頻率先完成具備 800G APN 服務能力的商用全光網路部署，不僅代表網路技術的重大升級，更是布局新世代數位基礎建設的重要里程碑。我們期待透過更高速、更智慧、更具韌性的網路，協助加速 AI 應用落地，同時並兼顧節能減碳與永續發展，實現科技創新與 ESG 並進，為台灣打造更具韌性的數位基礎建設，在全球 AI 與綠色轉型浪潮中建立數位競爭力與永續發展優勢。
paras_en: Chunghwa Telecom today announced that it has completed the deployment of its 400G APN all-optical network with 1Finity, a subsidiary of Fujitsu Group, and its Taiwanese technology partner DCH Technology. The 1Finity Ultra Optical System transmission system has been introduced in Chunghwa Telecom's commercial network environment, marking the completion of the 400G APN all-optical network deployment.

This collaboration is an important milestone in Chunghwa Telecom's layout of all-optical networks and a crucial step towards building AI-era network infrastructure. The first phase of the deployment involves introducing the 1Finity Ultra Optical System solution, which is based on all-optical transmission (All-Photonics) and photonic switching (Photonic Switching) as its core, to create an end-to-end high-speed transmission framework.

Compared to traditional network architectures, APN offers advantages such as high bandwidth, low latency, high reliability, and high scalability. It is expected to bring about a 5- to 20-fold increase in transmission capacity, a 50% to 90% reduction in network latency, and a 30% to 60% improvement in energy efficiency. Not only can it meet the current demands of AI computing, data center interconnection (DCI), and cloud services, but it also reserves upgrade space for next-generation ultra-high-speed transmission capabilities such as 1.2Tbps and 1.6Tbps, showcasing Chunghwa Telecom's forward-looking layout in Taiwan's all-optical network technology development.

On the other hand, in addition to overall performance upgrades, APN also considers the needs of sustainable development. By reducing network device energy consumption, improving light transmission efficiency, and enhancing overall resource utilization rates, it can effectively reduce carbon emissions from data centers and network infrastructure, helping enterprises accelerate AI innovation and digital transformation while meeting ESG governance, net-zero carbon, and sustainable operation goals, creating a new generation of high-performance and low-carbon digital infrastructure.

Chunghwa Group CEO Chen Zuo-ming said that the AI wave has accelerated global digital transformation and redefined the value of networks, from a simple information transmission pipeline to a critical infrastructure driving industry innovation and upgrading, and supporting AI computing, data center interconnection, smart cities, and national digital resilience.

Chen Zuo-ming pointed out that this time, Chunghwa Telecom has completed the commercial deployment of a 400G APN service-capable all-optical network, representing a major upgrade in network technology and an important milestone in laying out new-generation digital infrastructure. We expect to accelerate the landing of AI applications through faster, smarter, and more resilient networks, while also considering energy savings and carbon reduction, and achieving technological innovation and ESG progress, to create a more resilient digital infrastructure for Taiwan and establish digital competitiveness and sustainable development advantages in the global AI and green transformation wave.

items.title: Fed升息壓力大降 金價突破4400美元 黃金、白銀ETF強勁反彈
items.title_en: Fed Rate Hike Pressure Eases, Gold Price Breaks Through $4,400
paras: 美國非農就業指數低於預期，引發市場預期 Fed 升息機率大降，國際金價突破 4,400 美元 / 盎司大關，創下 9 周新高。國內貴金屬 ETF 表現強勁，今 (11) 日期元大 S&P 黃金正 2 (00708L-TW)、期元大 S&P 黃金 (00635U-TW)、期元大道瓊白銀 (00738U-TW) 再度連袂上漲，8 月以來漲幅已突破雙位數。
台股今 (11) 日盤整重返 45,000 點，貴金屬 ETF 則受惠升息疑慮暫緩，表現連日走升，00708L、00635U 與 00738U 於 7 月 FOMC 會議後，分別強漲 17.4%、8.6%、13.5%。
法人分析，美元轉弱以及避險需求回升，帶動黃金重新獲得買盤支撐。近期市場對進一步升息預期降溫，加上全球經濟成長與地緣政治不確定性仍高，使黃金避險屬性持續受到青睞；白銀價格則受惠於貴金屬投資氛圍轉佳，以及工業需求前景改善，同步黃金上漲。
雖上半年黃金表現承壓，但在 4,000 美元 / 盎司獲得強勁支撐，反映在全球不確定性仍高的環境下，黃金作為資產配置工具的價值依然受到市場重視，包括全球央行持續增持黃金的趨勢未見改變。其中，中國央行 7 月增持黃金約 64 萬盎司，連續 21 個月加碼，儲備量更是創下 2023 年 10 月以來新高。
在多重利多不變下，摩根大通預測金價有望 2026 年第四季突破 5,000 美元 / 盎司；華爾街指標造市商城堡證券也積極看漲，指出目前趨勢交易資金在黃金、白銀呈現淨空頭，一旦行情向上突破將帶動回補買盤，推升漲勢。

paras_en: The US non-farm employment index fell short of expectations, leading to a decline in the probability of a Fed rate hike, causing international gold prices to break through the $4,400 per ounce barrier, reaching a new high in 9 weeks. Domestic precious metal ETFs performed strongly, with S&P Gold (00708L-TW) and S&P Gold (00635U-TW) and S&P Silver (00738U-TW) rising again today, with an 8-month gain exceeding double digits.

The TAIEX returned to 45,000 points today, while precious metal ETFs benefited from the temporary easing of rate hike concerns, with 00708L, 00635U, and 00738U rising by 17.4%, 8.6%, and 13.5% respectively since the July FOMC meeting.

Analysts believe that the weakening dollar and the resurgence of risk aversion demand have driven gold to regain buying support. Market expectations of further rate hikes have cooled down recently, and the uncertainty of global economic growth and geopolitics remains high, making gold a preferred safe-haven asset; silver prices, on the other hand, have benefited from the improved investment environment for precious metals and the improved outlook for industrial demand, coinciding with the rise in gold prices.

Although gold prices were under pressure in the first half of the year, they have found strong support at $4,000 per ounce, reflecting the continued importance of gold as an asset allocation tool in a world where uncertainty remains high. This is evident in the continued trend of central banks increasing their gold holdings, including China's People's Bank of China, which added approximately 640,000 ounces in July, marking the 21st consecutive month of gold purchases, with reserves reaching a new high since October 2023.

Despite the multiple bullish factors, Morgan Stanley predicts that gold prices may break through $5,000 per ounce in the fourth quarter of 2026; Castle Securities, a market maker on Wall Street, is also optimistic, pointing out that the trend of net short positions in gold and silver is currently strong, and that a breakout to the upside will trigger a rebound in buying interest, driving the price higher.

items.title: AI疑慮引爆亞洲資金撤退！7月外資淨賣超254.8億美元 台灣成最大提款市場
items.title_en: AI Concerns Trigger Outflow of Foreign Capital from Asia! $2.548 Billion Net Selling by Foreigners in July, Taiwan Largest Withdrawal Market
paras: 2026年08月11日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI投資熱潮開始讓市場出現疑慮。隨著投資人擔心科技巨頭投入大量資金發展AI，卻未必能快速轉化成獲利，外資7月持續撤出亞洲股票，其中台灣與南韓賣壓最明顯。
根據LSEG統計，外資7月合計淨賣超南韓、台灣、印度、印尼、泰國、越南及菲律賓股票達254.8億美元，已連續第9個月呈現淨賣超。
其中，台灣是外資撤出最多的市場，7月淨賣超達229.5億美元，較6月約80億美元大幅增加；南韓也遭外資淨賣超62.6億美元，已連續第3個月出現資金流出。越南則小幅淨流出1,200萬美元。
為什麼外資大賣台灣與南韓？主要原因就在AI。
台灣與南韓股市集中了大量半導體、記憶體及AI相關企業，過去也是AI熱潮下最受資金青睞的亞洲市場之一。但現在投資人開始擔心，科技巨頭投入AI的資金愈來愈多，未來賺到的錢能不能跟得上投資速度。
尤其Alphabet(GOOGL-US)與特斯拉Tesla(TSLA-US)出現負現金流後，市場對AI投資的態度開始變得更加謹慎。投資人擔心的並不是「AI沒有需求」，而是企業為AI投入大量資金後，需要多久才能真正回收。
法國巴黎銀行分析師指出，台灣與南韓的AI重量級企業因此遭遇明顯賣壓，投資人開始重新檢視晶片需求是否能像原先預期那麼強，以及企業大量投資後的財務壓力。
不過，外資並不是全面撤出亞洲，而是把資金轉往其他市場。印度7月獲得21.2億美元外資淨流入，泰國淨流入14.6億美元，印尼與菲律賓則分別淨流入8,800萬美元及6,900萬美元。

paras_en: August 11, 2026 (Optimization Analysis / Industry Data Center Report) - The AI investment craze has started to raise concerns in the market. As investors worry that tech giants are pouring large amounts of capital into AI development without necessarily being able to quickly convert it into profits, foreign capital has continued to withdraw from Asian stocks in July, with Taiwan and South Korea showing the most significant selling pressure.

According to LSEG statistics, foreign capital sold a net of $2.548 billion in South Korea, Taiwan, India, Indonesia, Thailand, Vietnam, and the Philippines in July, marking the 9th consecutive month of net selling.

Among them, Taiwan was the market with the largest foreign capital outflow, with a net selling of $2.295 billion in July, a significant increase of about $8 billion from June; South Korea also saw a net outflow of $626 million, marking the third consecutive month of capital outflow. Vietnam saw a small net outflow of $12 million.
Why did foreign capital sell the most in Taiwan and South Korea? The main reason is AI.

Taiwan and South Korea's stock markets are concentrated with a large number of semiconductor, memory, and AI-related companies, which were also among the most favored Asian markets during the previous AI craze. However, investors have now started to worry that tech giants are pouring more and more capital into AI, and whether they can keep up with the investment pace.

Especially after Alphabet (GOOGL-US) and Tesla (TSLA-US) appeared with negative cash flow, the market's attitude towards AI investment has become more cautious. Investors are not worried that 'AI has no demand', but rather that companies will take how long to truly recover the investment after pouring a large amount of capital into AI.

A French Paris Bank analyst pointed out that Taiwan and South Korea's AI heavyweight companies have therefore faced significant selling pressure, and investors have started to re-examine whether chip demand can be as strong as previously expected, and the financial pressure on companies after large-scale investment.

However, foreign capital is not withdrawing from Asia in general, but rather transferring funds to other markets. India received a net inflow of $212 million in July, Thailand received a net inflow of $146 million, Indonesia received a net inflow of $88 million, and the Philippines received a net inflow of $69 million.

items.title: Sony、台積電傳聯手投資1兆日圓！規模達Sony感測事業年營收46.5%
items.title_en: Sony, TSMC Reportedly Partner to Invest ¥1 Trillion in Japan's Image Sensor Factory
paras: 2026年08月11日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 日本電子大廠Sony(6758-JP)傳出正與台積電(2330-TW)洽談，共同投資日本新的影像感測器工廠，投資規模可能達1兆日圓，目標在2029年開始量產。
根據彭博報導，雙方正在討論合作投資新廠的可能性。Sony是全球影像感測器重要供應商，產品廣泛應用於智慧型手機、汽車與其他電子設備，在工業 CMOS 感測器市場佔據55-60%的份額，在全局快門 CMOS 感測器供應方面更高達60~70%，目前部分感測器產品已透過台積電(2330-TW)Fab 14與Fab 18生產，若雙方最終攜手投資，合作關係將從既有日本半導體布局進一步擴大。
從Sony本身的營收規模來看，影像感測器已是集團重要事業。Sony截至2026年3月底止財年(FY2025)的Imaging & Sensing Solutions影像與感測解決方案營收達2.15兆日圓，較前一財年的1.79兆日圓成長約19.6%，占Sony整體營收約17.2%。
若以這項業務規模比較，此次傳出的1兆日圓投資金額，相當於Sony最新年度影像與感測解決方案營收約46.5%，顯示潛在投資規模並不小。
若合作最終成形，將進一步深化Sony與台積電在日本半導體供應鏈的合作關係，也反映Sony持續為中長期影像感測器需求擴充製造能力。不過，目前雙方仍處於洽談階段，1兆日圓投資規模、雙方實際出資比例及2029年量產時程，仍有待最終確認。

paras_en: August 11, 2026 (Opt Analytics/Industry Data Center Report) - Japanese electronics giant Sony (6758-JP) is reportedly in talks with Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (2330-TW) to jointly invest in a new image sensor factory in Japan, with an investment scale of ¥1 trillion, aiming to start mass production in 2029.

According to a Bloomberg report, the two parties are discussing the possibility of cooperating to invest in the new factory. Sony is a major supplier of image sensors globally, with its products widely used in smartphones, cars, and other electronic devices, occupying 55-60% of the industrial CMOS sensor market and 60-70% of the global shutter CMOS sensor supply. Currently, some of its sensor products are produced through TSMC's (2330-TW) Fab 14 and Fab 18, and if the two parties ultimately invest together, their partnership will further expand from their existing Japanese semiconductor layout.

From Sony's revenue scale, image sensors have become an important business for the group. Sony's Imaging & Sensing Solutions image and sensing solution revenue reached ¥2.15 trillion as of the end of its FY2025, up 19.6% from the previous year's ¥1.79 trillion, accounting for approximately 17.2% of Sony's overall revenue.

If this business scale is compared, the ¥1 trillion investment amount reported this time is equivalent to approximately 46.5% of Sony's latest annual image and sensing solution revenue, showing that the potential investment scale is not small.

If the cooperation ultimately takes shape, it will further deepen the partnership between Sony and TSMC in Japan's semiconductor supply chain, also reflecting Sony's continued efforts to expand its image sensor manufacturing capacity to meet medium- to long-term demand. However, the two parties are currently in the negotiation stage, and the ¥1 trillion investment scale, actual investment ratio, and 2029 production schedule are still to be confirmed.
